$comment: Baseline generated from the existing top-level packs/ directories. 'locked: true' means CI (.github/workflows/datapack-immutability.yml) will fail any pull request that touches a file under that directory. To edit a locked pack: open a PR that sets its entry to 'locked: false' and get it reviewed/merged first, make your change and merge it, then open a follow-up PR that sets it back to 'locked: true'. New top-level directories under packs/ that are not listed here at all are allowed through (that's how new packs get added) but should be added to this file, locked, in a prompt follow-up PR.
